title: Return Enchanted Golden Apples!
description: A datapack that returns the Enchanted Golden Apple Recipe right after 1.9's actions >:(
body:
# About the Datapack
A datapack that adds back the Enchanted Golden Apple Recipe before 1.9 removed it.

This datapack, "Return Enchanted Golden Apples!" adds back the recipe, ignoring 1.9's recipe removal. **DO NOT USE IN SERVERS THAT COMMONLY HAVE DIAMOND/NETHERITE ARMOR PLAYERS AS IT CAN RUIN THE ECONOMY!!**

# What's so bad about it being removed?
Well, in 1.20+, Mojang added AutoCrafters. **AND YOU KNOW WHAT THAT MEANS... No Enchanted Golden Apples farming!!!!!! Well, this datapack will do the trick. Be happy that the Enchanted Golden Apples AutoCrafting Farm now works!!**
